mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_PREPAYMENT WHERE SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT * FROM TBL_PREPAYMENT WHERE SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND REMAINING_AMOUNT > 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME ASC

SELECT p.PREPAYMENT_ID as prepaymentId, p.PREPAYMENT_NO as prepaymentNo, p.SUPPLIER_ID as supplierId, s.SUPPLIER_NAME as supplierName, p.PREPAYMENT_AMOUNT as prepaymentAmount, p.OFFSET_AMOUNT as offsetAmount, p.REMAINING_AMOUNT as remainingAmount, p.PREPAYMENT_STATUS as prepaymentStatus, p.PREPAYMENT_DATE as prepaymentDate, p.PAYMENT_METHOD as paymentMethod, p.SUMMARY as summary, p.REMARKS as remarks, p.CREATE_TIME as createTime, p.CREATE_BY as createBy FROM TBL_PREPAYMENT p LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON p.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID AND s.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE p.PREPAYMENT_ID = #{prepaymentId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 0
